title: Durable observability repair and escalation playbook for missing metrics & trace gaps
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Executive summary: Multiple customers across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private installations reported missing time series and broken console widgets during two production incidents (I-2025-321 and I-2025-324). Root pattern: intermittent telemetry ingestion pauses combined with a race in the dashboard tile reconciliation worker that dropped mapping to trace spans. This ticket seeks to implement a durable short-term repair, harden ingestion checkpointing, and codify an escalation playbook for on-call engineers and SEs to reduce MTTD/MTTR for similar incidents.
reproduction_steps: 1) Simulate burst ingestion of tenant metrics with a skewed timestamp distribution across ten partitions using loadgen-v2
2) Introduce a transient DB write latency spike on metrics-indexer (sleep 300ms) to trigger ingestion backpressure
3) Deploy a simultaneous dashboard reconciliation job and observe tile mapping behavior when indexer checkpoints are delayed
4) Verify trace link generation for sampled spans during the window of delayed checkpoints
investigation_notes: Telemetry ingestion pauses correlated with GC pauses on indexer JVMs in Dedicated environments (heap churn from a recent library bump), but Hosted instances showed network egress saturation in a single region
Dash reconciliation worker assumes monotonic checkpoint offsets; when ingestion reordered offsets may skip and reconciliation silently drops tiles because of missing tombstone handling
Trace correlation uses best-effort span stitching; when span indices are missing the UI shows empty trace links rather than a degraded message
Customer escalations included Slack threads and two SEs on high-priority support rotations; mitigation included manual reindex and a temporary increase in retention window for ingestion replay
decision_log: Decision 2025-11-03: Implement incremental backfill consumer that replays missing metric windows rather than full reindex (agreed by infra and runtime teams)
Decision 2025-11-04: Add explicit tombstone and offset gap detection in reconciliation worker and emit alert when gaps exceed threshold (owner: Diego)
Decision 2025-11-06: For Hosted, deploy network egress throttling guard in front of indexer during bursts to keep control-plane healthy (owner: Network)
Rejected option: Full synchronous reconciliation during ingestion — rejected due to unacceptable latency for heavy tenants
changes_proposed: 1) Fix: reconciliation worker will persist last-seen offsets and detect gaps; on gap detection it will pause, emit a high-severity alert, and enqueue a focused backfill job
2) Durable checkpoints: shard-level durable checkpointing for metrics-indexer (write-ahead offsets to KV store) so replay can be precise and fast
3) UI: change empty trace link behavior to show a "Trace unavailable - backfilling" hint and link to escalation playbook
4) Ops: create automated temporary retention expansion for affected tenants to avoid permanent data loss during replay
5) Tests: add chaos scenario CI that kills indexer GC and injects network latency while running dashboard reconciliation
rollout_plan: Phase A: Hotfix to reconciliation worker (canary on staging + one low-traffic region) -> Phase B: Durable checkpointing + durable backfill consumer (staged rollout across Hosted regions, then Dedicated pools) -> Phase C: UI hint + runbook publication -> Phase D: Add chaos CI and scheduled reindex smoke test
monitoring_queries: metrics_indexer_checkpoint_lag > 5m for any tenant -> alert P0
ingest_write_latency_p95 > 250ms -> create ticket and raise to infra

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation worker emits a durable alert when offset gaps are detected and no tiles are dropped silently
Backfill consumer can replay specific offset windows and restore dashboard tiles within SLA (target 90 minutes for P0 customers)
Durable checkpointing persists offsets and survives process restarts (tested with chaos CI)
Hosted regions show no repeat of missing-metrics incidents in 30 days after rollout (monitoring window)
rollback_plan: If reconciliation hotfix introduces regressions, rollback to previous worker binary and trigger on-call to run manual focused reindex for affected tenants; feature flags will control durable checkpoint read/write paths to allow fast rollback.
notes_for_support: Step 2: If span links missing, open temporary UI hint via feature flag for tenant and notify SE
Step 3: Escalate to Diego and SRE on-call if backfill fails or lag > 3 hours
